rationale: Genuine decision differs from the blind planted copy only in recommended_provisional_status ("no" vs "yes"); all other fields byte-equivalent. I re-hashed the held texts and checked exact spans: ORIGINAL:EO:10773 (EO_10773.txt ae4640e8..., 23 FR 5061, signed 1958-07-01; title and date agree with API observation API:139ee1493a4d82999af6ec94), ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11051 (FR original EO_11051.txt, 27 FR 9683, signed 1962-09-27) and ACT:EO:10773>EO:11051 (APP mirror span 25113-25774 equal to the stored provision_text). I read the held original: sec. 1 identifies the ODCM; sec. 2 delegates Reorganization Plan No. 1 of 1958 functions and redelegates ODM/FCDA functions; secs. 3-4 amend references in prior orders. It is truncated at 'Continued on p. 5063', so later sections are not held, as the producer discloses. EO 11051 sec. 604 in the FR text reads 'To the extent that the following have not heretofore been made or become inapplicable, they are hereby superseded and revoked' and lists '(9) Executive Order No. 10773 of July 1, 1958' (and (10) EO 10782, its amendment). The only savings parenthetical attaches to item (7) EO 10539. The earlier acts are partial: EO 10782 renames offices, EO 10952 amends, EO 10958 supersedes only for functions it delegates. The 'to the extent' qualifier cannot keep alive a part 11051 leaves standing; it only recognises earlier partial supersession, so whole-order NO follows. The history flag PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLAUSE_CHECK is honestly resolved. The cruden number search (17 files) finds no later revival. The EO 10941 page hits, which I raised in the blind review, are 1961 OCDM disaster notices on the same FR pages that cite EO 10773 as authority; they are not an earlier end, so I withdraw that point. No effective date beyond signing is asserted. Remaining lifecycle gaps: the unheld 23 FR 5063 continuation and complete clause inventory, the first-effective date of EO 11051, reconciliation of earlier partial supersession by EO 10958, the absence of a complete later-source search, and page-image confirmation (original_pages_confirmed false). This is a nonauthoritative provisional NO proposal only.
